analyst.summary: Titagarh Rail Systems is working through a sharp normalization after the recent Indian Railways wagon-ordering boom: profit fell 55% year-on-year, free cash flow has been negative for two straight years despite reported accounting profit, and the promoter has meaningfully reduced its stake. Despite this, the stock still trades near 72 times trailing earnings. We see limited margin of safety here and recommend continuing to treat it as a Sell.
